% BioKGSuite manuscript — working draft, figures inline.
%
% Build:  latexmk -pdf main.tex
% Update body from Word:  python convert.py "/path/to/manuscript.docx"
%
% body.tex is machine-generated by convert.py and is overwritten on every
% run. Edit the Word file, not body.tex. This preamble and references.bib
% are hand-maintained.

\documentclass[11pt,a4paper]{article}

% ------------------------------------------------------------------ layout
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{microtype}
\setlength{\parskip}{0.55em}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}

% ------------------------------------------------------------- typography
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
% Times-like body face, close to Nature's. newtx is nicer but is not in a
% base TeX Live install; mathptmx ships everywhere.
\IfFileExists{newtxtext.sty}
  {\usepackage{newtxtext,newtxmath}}
  {\usepackage{mathptmx}}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- figures
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{float}
\usepackage[font=small,labelfont=bf,justification=raggedright,
            singlelinecheck=false,skip=6pt]{caption}
\graphicspath{{../figures/}}

% ----------------------------------------------------------------- tables
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{multirow}

% ------------------------------------------------------------------ misc
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{textcomp}

% Word exports typographic characters that inputenc does not know by default.
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2212}{\textminus}   % minus sign
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2264}{$\leq$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2265}{$\geq$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{00D7}{$\times$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{03C7}{$\chi$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{00B7}{\textperiodcentered}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2011}{-}            % non-breaking hyphen
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2248}{$\approx$}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage[colorlinks=true,allcolors=black,citecolor=black]{hyperref}

% pandoc emits these; define them so body.tex compiles unmodified
\providecommand{\tightlist}{%
  \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}
\providecommand{\pandocbounded}[1]{#1}

% -------------------------------------------------------------- citations
\usepackage[numbers,sort&compress,super]{natbib}
\bibliographystyle{unsrtnat}          % falls back to unsrtnat if absent

% --------------------------------------------------------------- headings
\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\section}{\normalfont\large\bfseries}{\thesection}{0.6em}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\normalfont\normalsize\bfseries}{}{0em}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{1.6em}{0.5em}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{1.2em}{0.35em}

% ===========================================================================
\begin{document}

\input{body}

\clearpage
\bibliography{references}

\end{document}
